summary.text: Gina Mitten is the Democratic candidate for Missouri State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
She represented District 83 in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2013 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Gina Mitten grew up in University City, according to her campaign website, and after living in Los Angeles for several years returned to St. Louis.
The site says she served on the Richmond Heights City Council before her election to the Missouri House.
Mitten assumed office in the Missouri House of Representatives, District 83, on January 9, 2013, and left on January 6, 2021, without running for re-election in 2020.
In the 2019-2020 session her committee assignments included vice chair of the Ethics Committee and ranking minority member of the Judiciary Committee.
Her campaign website lists workers' rights, public safety, and public education among her priorities for District 4.
